fields.label: Name
Activation Date
Make submissions confidential. Checking this box will hide who the evaluator is from admins and any evaluatees.
fields.name: anonymous

fields.label: Automatic Alerts When evaluation is submitted by the evaluator send an email to the following people with a link to download the completed form as a PDF.
fields.name: submission_alert_type

fields.label: Manual Alerts Gives evaluators the option to send an email to the selected people with a link to download the completed form as a PDF.
fields.name: submission_alert_type

fields.label: No submission alert
fields.name: submission_alert_type

fields.label: Low Score Alerts Gives evaluators the ability to set up an email to notify selected individuals when a specified low score scenario has been triggered. Recipients of the email will be able to download and review the evaluation as a PDF immediately.
fields.name: alert_type_3

fields.label: Evaluatee Acknowledgement Alert (Disagree Only) When enabled, the selected users will receive an email notification whenever an evaluatee disagrees with their evaluation assessment. Requires: Enable Evaluatee Acknowledgement (in Evaluation Review Settings below) to collect responses. To send these emails, first turn on Enable Evaluatee Acknowledgement below.
fields.name: alert_type_4

fields.label: Overdue Evaluation Alerts Select the program administrators who should be notified and receive the Assignment Status Report if this evaluation is not completed by the due date.
fields.name: alert_type_5

fields.label: No Alerts Clears every alert above. This is the default for a new evaluation.
fields.name: no_alerts

fields.label: Disable "Unable to Assess" option Hide the "Submit as Unable to Assess" button on evaluation forms. Evaluators will not be able to mark evaluations as "Unable to Assess".
fields.name: disable_unable_to_assess

fields.label: Require evaluator signature Evaluators will need to create a signature in their profile or draw one when submitting this evaluation.
fields.name: signature_required

fields.label: Post a review when this form is submitted on behalf of another user Records a review credited to the submitter and allows them to attach the original paper or PDF. Forms with a posted review do not appear in the Pending Review by Administrator queue.
fields.name: enable_auto_review_on_behalf_submission

fields.label: Select...

Enable Review Process - When enabled, feedback through this form will be exchanged between the evaluatee and the evaluator. The evaluation will appear under the "For My Review" status on the Reviews page, depending on whose turn it is to provide feedback. This process continues until one party marks the evaluation review process as complete.
fields.name: review_process_initiator

fields.label: Evaluatee Initiates Review (Default) - The evaluatee will first see the evaluation under the "For My Review" view and will initiate the review process.
fields.name: review_initiator_evaluatee

fields.label: Evaluator Initiates Review - The evaluator will first see the evaluation under the "For My Review" view and will initiate the review process.
fields.name: review_initiator_evaluator

fields.label: Enable Evaluatee Acknowledgement - When enabled, this setting adds an acknowledgement step where evaluatees must agree or disagree with their overall evaluation assessment and may leave optional comments (unless hidden below). Required for Evaluatee Acknowledgement Alert (Disagree Only).
fields.name: enable_evaluatee_acknowledgement

fields.label: Hide comment field for evaluatees - Evaluatees can still acknowledge and sign off on completed evaluations, but no comment box is shown. Earlier comments are kept.
fields.name: hide_evaluatee_sign_off_comment

fields.label: Hide comment field for evaluators - Evaluators can still sign off on completed evaluations, but no comment box is shown. Earlier comments are kept.
fields.name: hide_evaluator_sign_off_comment

fields.label: Require results to be published before evaluatee can view them When enabled, completed evaluation results will be hidden from the evaluatee until an admin publishes them. This reuses the same publish workflow used for confidential evaluations.
fields.name: require_publish_before_evaluatee_view

fields.label: This is a graded evaluation form. Calculate and display the overall score. When this setting is enabled, the form will calculate and display the overall score on the interface as well as on the bottom of the exported evaluation PDF. If left unchecked, the form will not calculate or display an overall score, and the evaluation will be treated as ungraded.
fields.name: display_grade_score_information

fields.label: Display the potential score values next to each question so they are visible when filling out the evaluation. When enabled, the score for each individual question will be visible to the evaluator as they complete the form. If unchecked, the evaluator will only see the overall score at the bottom of the form without seeing the breakdown of individual values to the questions.
fields.name: display_score_values

fields.label: Allow this form to be requested from non-Medtrics evaluators. When enabled, students can request an evaluation on this form from someone who doesn't have a Medtrics account, via either an email link or a shareable QR code.
fields.name: allow_external_request
